description: Apply an assembly type to existing standard walls, copying its layers and total thickness as the wall panel does. type null clears the assembly and keeps thickness. All walls change together. Refused with unknown_wall_type for an unknown type id, target_not_found for a missing wall, curtain_wall or railing_wall for walls that take no assembly.

anyOf.description: Assembly type id from get_walls.wallTypes: a built-in preset or custom- project wall type. Copies its layers and total thickness in metres, overriding thickness. Unknown ids: unknown_wall_type.

name: set_wall_type
title: Set wall type
